🇪🇺 Europe is putting AI giants on notice

The EU has started talks with OpenAI and Anthropic as it prepares to enforce the world’s first comprehensive AI law.

From August 2, developers of the most advanced AI models will have to meet strict new rules on AI safety, transparency, and risk management. The move comes after a string of high-profile AI agent incidents raised concerns about how powerful these systems are becoming.

Companies that fail to comply could face eye-watering penalties of up to 7% of their global annual revenue.
